_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Container Design Retrieval System (CDRS) Data Input
summary: The Container Design Retrieval System (CDRS) Data Input updates the DoD's computerized CDRS database with container design data, helping avoid designing new specialized containers when suitable ones already exist.
use_relationship:
The Container Design Retrieval System (CDRS) Data Input is used to continually update the Department of Defense (DoD) computerized CDRS database, and is accessible at https://lts.cce.af.mil/CDRS. Usage of the CDRS database precludes the design of new specialized containers when suitable containers exist and has a proven history of substantial cost avoidance.
This system is maintained by the Air Force Packaging Technology and Engineering Facility (AFPTEF) at Wright-Patterson AFB, http://www.aflcmc.af.mil/afptef.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
b. This DID supersedes DI-PACK-80684D.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The CDRS Data Input shall be in the contractor's format. The CDRS can be accessed at https://lts.cce.af.mil/CDRS. Completed CDRS Data Input shall be emailed to: CDRS@us.af.mil. Requestors with government Common Access Cards (CACs) can also submit data through CDRS.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The CDRS Data Input shall specify the following container design characteristics:

children.title: Drawing number, Commercial or Government Entity (CAGE) Code, or design agency.
Reference documents, such as, identified technical report number, specification number, and sources for this information.
Tare weight
children.content: the weight in pounds of the empty container, including dunnage, in decimal values of one significant digit.

children.title: Maximum gross weight
children.content: the weight in pounds of the container, dunnage, and heaviest item shipped in the container in decimal values of one significant digit.

children.title: Quantity pack
children.content: number of items packed in a single container.

children.title: High temperature (F)
children.content: the upper temperature limits to which the container can be subjected and still function properly as determined by specification requirements, analysis, or testing.

children.title: Low temperature (F)
children.content: the lower temperature limits to which the container can be subjected and still function properly as determined by specification requirements, analysis, or testing.

children.title: Container characteristics
children.content: major material used in container construction, container shape, container opening type, and type of shock mitigation system used.

children.title: Stacking height
children.content: the maximum superimposed load (in pounds) that the container, with item, can support or has been tested to (include specification number or test method).

children.title: Design cost
children.content: cost of designing, developing, prototyping, and testing container.

children.title: Unit price
children.content: the production unit cost of manufacturing the container relative to quantity purchased.

children.title: Packaged item designation
children.content: the official alpha-numeric assigned to the packaged item per MIL-STD-2073-1, Standard Practice for Military Packaging. (Copies of this document are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

children.title: Packaged item nomenclature
children.content: the official name or title assigned, for example, fuse, bomb, engine, computer.
